value.behaviour: Tags each history entry with the page active when it was recorded, and makes undo/redo and the empty-stack flags act only on the active page's entries.
rules: The constructor becomes `constructor(private readonly store: Store, private readonly getActivePageId: () => string | null = () => null)`; with the default getter every entry is untagged and the behaviour is exactly as today.
A private `entryPageIds = new WeakMap<HistoryDelta, string | null>()` holds each entry's page; `undoStack`/`redoStack` stay public `HistoryDelta[]` arrays with unchanged element type.
A private `isOnActivePage(entry)` is true when the entry's tag is null/undefined or equals `getActivePageId()`.
`isUndoStackEmpty` / `isRedoStackEmpty` are true when no entry of the respective stack is on the active page.
`record` tags the new entry with `getActivePageId()`; the redo stack reset removes only the redo entries on the active page (filter in place via splice), leaving other pages' redo entries.
The static `pop(stack)` is replaced by a private instance `popForActivePage(stack)` that removes and returns the last entry for which `isOnActivePage` holds (scanning from the end), else null.

`perform` remembers the page tag of the entry it popped; every entry it pushes (including a delta produced by `applyLatestChanges`) is tagged with that same page; the static `push` keeps its shape and returns the pushed inverse so it can be tagged.
A new public `notifyActivePageChanged()` triggers `onHistoryChangedEmitter` with the current flags, so undo/redo buttons refresh after a page switch.
`clear()` is unchanged (a WeakMap needs no clearing).
